description: This file is a Java class implementing a Data Access Object (DAO) for managing module configuration entities in the sales manager application, providing methods to retrieve modules by name or code.

classes.name: ModuleConfigurationDaoImpl
classes.description: Implementation of ModuleConfigurationDao interface for accessing module configuration data from the database.

methods.name: getModulesConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves a list of IntegrationModule objects matching the specified module name.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a single IntegrationModule object matching the specified module code.
